title: "SMACCL Documentation"

## Overview

SMACCL is a Python/OpenCL implementation of atmospheric correction workflows based
on the SMAC model family. The repository contains:

- Core correction kernels and runtime in `smaccl/`
- Sensor-specific readers/writers and processing orchestration
- Configuration files for representative processing scenarios
- Tests and notebooks for development and validation

## What This Project Solves

SMACCL transforms top-of-atmosphere observations into surface reflectance-related
products while propagating uncertainty terms used by downstream pipelines.

## Main Components

- `smaccl/smaccl.py`: low-level OpenCL-backed correction engine (`Smaccl`)
- `smaccl/ISmaccl.py`: high-level interface and xarray-oriented execution (`ISmaccl`)
- `smaccl/c3s_smaccl.py`: end-to-end processing entrypoint driven by config files
- `smaccl/c3s_io.py` and `smaccl/c3s_io_modis.py`: sensor I/O helpers
- `smaccl/c3s_lib.py`: ancillary and geophysical utility functions

## Typical Execution Path

1. Load a config file (paths, coefficients, sensor/platform, output switches)
2. Load scene data and ancillary datasets (MERRA2/CAMS, DEM, aerosol fractions)
3. Run chunked correction via `Smaccl` kernels
4. Write corrected outputs and uncertainty variables to NetCDF
